label: The Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary (Die 8 decembris)

chants.notes: Mode 3 per the printed heading 'Antiphona ad introitum III'. The back-of-book index (hence gr_index_entry row 1058) read mode 5 -> gregobase 655, a DIFFERENT chant: 622 (mode 3, GR1961 p.400) and 655 (mode 5, GR1961 p.103**) are separate chant_groups/melodies, both Solesmes. The page decides: clef on the top line (c4 = 622; 655 is c3) and the melody opens LOW on 'AUDENS'. Heading-numeral=mode verified on p543/p570/p575. Row 1058 corrected to mode 3 / gregobase 622 on 2026-08-28.

Band also includes a printed rubric below the communio: 'Cant. Magnificat, Lc. 1, 46-47, 48. 50. 51. 52. 53. 54. 55' — a canticle-verse continuation note for the communion antiphon, not a separate chant.
